name: Windows Settings Manager Pro
description:
Change your PC into the mode you need with one key.

Windows Settings Manager Pro combines live Windows system controls with user-created PC Modes. Save GAMING, WORK, NIGHT, PRESENT, and MOVIE as starting mode slots, rename them if you want, and choose exactly which settings each mode is allowed to change. PackRat does not apply mystery gaming optimizations or overwrite settings you did not select.

A PC Mode can include HDR on Windows 11 24H2 or later, display topology, power plan, screen and sleep timeouts, and Keep Awake. Each setting is applied independently and verified against Windows. A mode reports COMPLETE only when every configured step succeeds; mixed outcomes are PARTIAL instead of a fake success.

Pro also includes the individual HDR, power, display, timeout, Keep Awake, Lock PC, and system status actions from Lite. Live keys poll Windows so outside changes are reflected.

Includes editable PC Modes and Settings profile pages for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, Stream Deck Neo, Galleon 100 SD, and Stream Deck + XL.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.3 or later. HDR control requires Windows 11 24H2 or later plus compatible display hardware and drivers; the other controls remain available on supported Windows 10/11 systems.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- User-created PC Modes with Apply, Cycle, Current, and Save Current Mode actions.
- Per-setting mode control for HDR, display topology, power plan, screen/sleep timeouts, and Keep Awake.
- Verified COMPLETE, PARTIAL, and FAILED mode outcomes instead of all-or-nothing success claims.
- All Lite controls with live external Windows state refresh.
- Editable PC Modes and Settings profiles for seven current Stream Deck device families, including Galleon 100 SD and Stream Deck + XL.
